output.reason: The brief makes a convincing case that the departures are concentrated on Kestrel (8 of 11 on the matter left, against 1 of 13 who never worked on it) and that pay is a weak explanation, and it gives sensible next steps; it falls short of top marks because it leaves workload versus supervision unresolved and has a small inconsistency in its non-Kestrel headcount (13 versus 12).
